extracted.intended_audience: readers of humorous fiction; P. G. Wodehouse fans
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from P. G. Wodehouse's comic novel (Psmith, Journalist) presenting episodic humorous scenes—a boxing exhibition, street brawl, and petty gang warfare—rendered in Wodehouse's characteristic deadpan, hyperbolic style. The text is narrative fiction rather than a guideline or rubric.
